capability_gate.note: CONJUNCTION. Vindicated four times: ppl and generation diversity disagreed in residual-binary vs affine, PQ d=4, PQ d=2, and the sparse correction.

MECHANISMS.property: the ONLY class that passes both gate conditions on this specimen. Group size trades scale overhead against fidelity; g128 beats g64 at equal bits.

clears perplexity below 2.5 EBPW and fails repetition by 4x. Collapses many sub-vectors onto one centroid, narrowing expert output range. Sub-vector dimension is a TRADE AXIS: d=2 halves repetition and costs likelihood; d=4 reverses it. SCARRED as a whole representation; retained as a residual primitive.
MAGNITUDE information. Restoring the top 0.2% by |w| gives the best perplexity of any sub-2.5 arm and makes repetition WORSE. Buys likelihood, never geometry.
the 1-bit grammar bottoms out at 1.3457 EBPW; down_proj is 1408=2^7*11 so its group is pinned at 128 and contributes 0.0417 b/w of irreducible scale overhead. Dead at every rate.
at IDENTICAL bytes to affine q2 it loses on perplexity and ELIMINATES the 87-token repetition collapse. Same budget buys either likelihood or loop-freedom.

REFUTED BY SPECTRUM on two architectures. Experts span ~0.98 of maximum possible directions, so no basis of R<n captures them. magnitude and cosine collapse TOGETHER (0.39, 0.39), unlike every quantization arm.
dominated everywhere: worse perplexity than PQ at higher cost.

NOT a representation - a modifier that improves FOUR classes at IDENTICAL bytes: binary -7.1% and -10.3%, residual binary -11.7%, PQ -3.1%. The most reproducible effect measured. Strongest transfer candidate.
REFUTED BY ARITHMETIC. A single 1408x2048 expert has participation 867.6/1408; a rank-794 factorisation costs 15.23 b/w and rank-1216 costs 23.32 -- MORE than dense at 16.

FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.finding: MoE expert organs are near-maximally independent across experts (~0.98 of maximum) and ~0.61 effective rank within each matrix
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.falsifier: cross-expert ratio below ~0.95 or within-expert below ~0.4
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.action: skip every linear sharing class on sight; run the 5-minute screen first

FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.finding: weight-space reconstruction error does not rank capability
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.evidence: PQ had 45% lower error than affine at FEWER bits and worse capability; cosine ranked resbinary highest and it had the worst perplexity
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.falsifier: a specimen where error ordering matches capability ordering across classes
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.action: use error as a cheap filter only; never rank final candidates by it

FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.finding: likelihood and generation diversity are separate axes that move independently
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.falsifier: a specimen where the two never diverge across classes
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.action: the capability gate must stay a conjunction

FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.finding: per-expert activation calibration beats pooled at identical bytes
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.evidence: four classes on O003, same direction
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.falsifier: a specimen where per-expert is neutral or worse
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.action: apply by default; test on specimen 2

FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.finding: byte reduction below q4 does not buy decode speed
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.evidence: bf16 452 GB/s at 56.5% of peak; every quantized arm 18-23%. Below q4 decode is not bandwidth-bound.
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.falsifier: a kernel that reaches >40% of peak on a quantized body
FINDINGS_CLASSIFIED.action: fix the compressed GPU path before spending more on bytes

COMPOUNDING_EVIDENCE.specimen_1_cost: hours - built a shared-basis NR to learn experts are independent
COMPOUNDING_EVIDENCE.specimen_2_cost: five minutes - three spectra gave the same answer before any construction
